note: Six MI rows. Five small Huron and Hiawatha NF / Pictured Rocks campgrounds added, then the AuSable River dispersed-site system added as its three clusters of 23-ft-capable drive-in sites (Sawmill Point, Alcona Pond, Lower Ausable) at AWH's call. The rest of that system - boat-in, walk-to and 18-ft sites at Cooke, Foote, Five Channels and Loud ponds and the semi-primitive area - is not in.
